shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'tsconfig*'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'charts|chartkit' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && ls -la'

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button SegmentedRadioGroup Select ThemeProvider useTheme useThemeValue useThemeContext && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && rg -n -C 4 'useTheme|ThemeProvider|base-background|info|spacing' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/charts version peerDependencies && npm install @gravity-ui/charts'

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button SegmentedRadioGroup Select ThemeProvider useTheme useThemeValue useThemeContext && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && rg -n -C 4 'useTheme|ThemeProvider|base-background|info|spacing' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeContext.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts | rg '(INDEX.md|types.*d.ts|Chart.*d.ts|theme.*css|styles.css)"'$'"' | head -50"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'line|theming|axis|tooltip|legend|ChartData|Chart' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md | head -160 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/theming.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/series-types/line.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-labels.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/index.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/tooltip.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/colors.md'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -Ls https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/gravity-icons.html && python - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/tmp/gravity-icons.html').read()
for term in ['sun','moon','calendar','arrow-down','chart-line','chevron-right','circle-info','person','clock']:
 matches=re.findall(r'.{0,50}'+term+r'.{0,90}',s,re.I)
 print(term, matches[:3])
PY
npm install @gravity-ui/icons"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'ChartData|ChartProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/index.d.ts && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types | head -35 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types/series/line.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types/chart.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md && node -p \"require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json').version\""

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,re
s=urllib.request.urlopen('https://gravity-ui.com/icons').read().decode()
for term in ['sun','moon','calendar','arrow-down','chart-line','chevron-right','circle-info','person','clock','arrow-up-right','circle-check']:
 matches=re.findall(r'.{0,35}'+term+r'.{0,65}',s,re.I)
 print(term, matches[:2])
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/index.d.ts; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types | head -45; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm | rg '/(line|chart|axis|x-axis|y-axis|tooltip|legend).*d.ts"'$'"' | head -40; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md; node -p \"require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json').version\""

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types/index.d.ts && rg -n 'export type ChartData|interface ChartData|type ChartProps|interface ChartProps|dashStyle|lineWidth|tickInterval|grid|pixelInterval|tickCount' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/{components,types,plugins,core} -g '*.d.ts' | head -65 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(Sun|Moon|Calendar|ArrowDownToLine|ChartLine|ChevronRight|CircleInfo|Persons|Clock|ArrowUpRight|CircleCheck|Display|Check|CircleQuestionMark)\\.(d.ts|js)"'$'"' | head -35 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -145"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,135p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/index.d.ts && sed -n '1,155p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts && sed -n '145,290p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts && sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/components/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/chart.d.ts && rg -n -- '--g-color-(text-utility|line-utility|base-utility|infographics|base-float|base-generic)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/themes/_light.scss | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts && sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/legend.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts && rg -o -- '--g-color-(?:text-utility|line-utility|base-utility-[a-z]+|infographics-[a-z-]+|base-float|base-generic-[a-z]+|text-positive|base-positive-light|base-neutral-light)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | head -55 && cat tsconfig.json && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'value\\??:|onUpdate\\??:|options\\??:|aria-label|width\\??:|size\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -85 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeType.d.ts && rg -n -C 2 'DashStyle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/constants.d.ts | head -15 && sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/tooltip.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/base.d.ts | head -48"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'getComputedStyle|var\\(--|resolve.*[Cc]olor' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/utils -g '*.js' | head -20 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -45 && rg -n -C 2 'DashStyle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/constants/index.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/marker.d.ts | head -85 && rg -n -C 2 'color\\(|rgb\\(|interpolate|opacity' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/tooltip/utils.js | head -55 && rg -n -C 1 -- '--g-button-(padding|text-color)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | head -20 && git status --short && cat src/main.tsx && cat .gitignore"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build > /tmp/pulse-build.log 2>&1'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && tail -n 8 /tmp/pulse-build.log'
